issues.where: the main crater, its feeder and the neighboring right-hand pools
issues.what: the lake is a wider bowl displaced up and left relative to the pools; the feeder now enters almost from directly above instead of reaching the upper-left shore, and the two right-hand pools sit noticeably higher
issues.fix: restore the target's more upright bowl and the relative positions of the river mouth and satellite pools

issues.where: the rusty upland northeast of the large inlet
issues.what: the broad field of dark round basins is largely replaced by long ridges; the few surviving pits are crowded against the far-right edge
issues.fix: bring back the scattered dark basins within the rust-colored upland, including the larger ones, without removing the added relief elsewhere

issues.where: the rusty saddle between the left basin group and the right ridge country
issues.what: most of the target's prominent dark round pools are missing, leaving a more continuous reddish slope
issues.fix: reopen the clustered dark pools in the saddle and retain the rusty ground between them

issues.where: the ochre shelf and feeder delta inside the main lake
issues.what: the mineral margin forms thick smooth bands and the delta ends in a few broad pale spokes, rather than the target's fine branching fingers, irregular staining and curled southwest shoal
issues.fix: break up the orange rings into irregular translucent shoals and restore dendritic channels at the mouth and the southwest curl

issues.where: over the upper-right arc of the main lake
issues.what: the target's thin white vapour follows the inner rim over dark water; the soft light veil in the revision sits mostly on the outer rock
issues.fix: carry a narrow translucent streamer over the water along the inside of the rim

issues.where: the isolated small pool to the lower right of the main lake
issues.what: the shoreline is a nearly smooth oval where the target has an irregular two-lobed outline with a distinct constriction
issues.fix: restore the two lobes and their pinched, uneven shoreline

issues.what: at native size, extensive opaque tan shapes read as rock well out into the dark sea, where the target reads as open blue water with small white cloud flecks
issues.fix: keep the layered clouds and sea shadows, but confine solid tan forms to the near-coast shallows and let offshore gaps read as continuous deep blue

issues.where: above the northeast rust field and the upper edge of the large inlet
issues.what: diffuse cloud patches remain, but the target's long translucent streamers with a clear sweep across the rust field are no longer legible
issues.fix: restore a few connected, wind-aligned white vapour ribbons over this region without flattening the cloud layers

issues.where: southwest tidal fringe below the middle crater
issues.what: sharp pale loops outline bright turquoise patches; they read like drawn contours rather than the target's soft submerged channels
issues.fix: soften and interrupt those loops, letting the turquoise fade naturally into deeper blue away from recognizable shallow channels

issues.where: the right-hand crest faces on both sides of the central channel
issues.what: a broad chalk-gray wash covers whole slopes, muting the target's narrow warm rock highlights and blue-green shadow tones
issues.fix: keep the greater relief and land area, but limit the light mineral color to exposed crests and bring cool blue-green and rust back into the shaded faces

issues.where: above the left basin group and across the central rust saddle
issues.what: broken cloud patches replace the distinct long pale streamers that curve over the saddle in the target
issues.fix: restore the directional vapour filaments while keeping the added cloud depth

issues.where: the southern shoreline and offshore sea below the left basin group
issues.what: bright gray threads make tight loops over dark water and around islands; in the native crop they lack the target's gradual blue-green shallows and tapering streaks
issues.fix: replace the hard looping edges with translucent, tapering filaments and smooth the shallow-to-deep water transition
